description: Worklog/timesheet policy checker - run a batch of worklog entries through configurable guardrails BEFORE posting them to a time-tracking system. Checks: rounding increment (default 0.25h, float-safe), per-entry min/max, per-author daily totals, duplicates, over-estimate alerts (never suggests inflating hours or estimates - flags to PM instead), future dates, weekends, immutable-author edit protection, missing description/ticket. Returns pass/warnings/blocked verdict + per-entry violations with fixes + hour totals by author and date. Caller supplies the reference date - fully deterministic, no LLM.

entries.description: The entries to check, up to 500.

already_logged_hours.description: Hours already on the ticket before this entry.

delete.description: True if this deletes an existing worklog.

edit.description: True if this edits an existing worklog.

estimate_hours.description: Ticket estimate, for the over-estimate check.

id.description: Existing worklog id; on an immutable author this counts as an update.

new.description: True if this is a new entry even though it carries an id.

policy.description: Optional overrides of the default policy. Unknown keys are rejected.

immutable_authors.description: Authors whose existing worklogs must never be edited or deleted.

rounding_increment.description: Hours must be a multiple of this. Default 0.25.

name: worklog_guardrail
